files.notes: Tailwind and autoprefixer plugin config.
Reads health revision via curl+sed then edits guide constant; refuses empty/short revision. Does not require curl HTTP success or verify exactly one replacement. NOT executed.
Mounts LanguageProvider, AuthProvider, confirmation provider, sandbox banner and route tree.
Controlled draft, imperative focus/clear/getValue, trim/send/clear, Enter and IME state guard, global Ctrl/Cmd K listener removed on cleanup.

React text markdown subset: inline bold/code/link plus fenced blocks/lists/headings; http(s) URL allowlist. Nested capturing split groups duplicate link components; unfinished code fence buffered and not flushed.
Polls first running trader rather than selected account; missing/error positions render no open positions; alphabetic MNQ follows US-stock shares display.
Loads/adds/removes preferences via business-response HTTP client; load ignores success flag; load promises not canceled or generation checked on token changes.
Login/password UI and destructive-reset request button. Mount clears auth storage without clearing auth context. Reset backend is protected and gated; this unauthenticated UI cannot bypass it.
Static registration-disabled notice and login navigation.
Password strength/confirmation form calling auth reset. Backend permanently returns410, so current form advertises an unavailable path; not an account-takeover finding.

Lightweight Charts candles/volume/MA/EMA/Bollinger, markers, pending price lines and server SVP. Polling without request generation or abort; stale closure toggles, last-bar-open marker range, stale cached markers, UTC seconds with mixed tooltip timezone, crypto quote units for MNQ. Cleanup removes chart/interval/observer but leaves refs and pending fetches.
Diagnostic counts and status, not actual candles; catches trade fetch error separately so data-success display can mask failed order read; no refresh/cancellation.

Batch equity30s SWR; minute buckets latest timestamp, forward fills gaps, trims latest500points, ranks currentPnL. Sorted-ID cache key stores arrays in input order: reordering same traders can assign histories to wrong trader. Missing/error values become zero/no history; viewer-local times.
Apache-attributed pixel-alignment primitives for centered line and bounded box sizing; no external mutation.
Decorative static/animated backgrounds; animated version references remote grain texture; disabledAnimation static variant.
Substring-normalized crypto exchange icon mapping, unknown including NT falls back first letter.
Desktop/mobile auth-gated navigation, language, user menu and stored beginner/advanced mode; outside-click listener removed. Empty malformed email can throw at email[0].
Static formula definitions, KaTeX rendering fallback, fixed portal placement and translated labels; formulas are explanatory not engine calculations; fixed width may overflow narrow viewports.
Suffix model icon/color map, case-sensitive known tokens; unknown icon null and color fallback.
Seed hash deterministic SVG pixel avatar and hair/eye/mouth/accessory local renderers; nibble shifts wrap after32bits so accessory traits correlated, cosmetic only.
Shown only for truthy system config sandbox; absent/failed config hides marker, not proof of live safety.
Translated footer title/warning display.
Fetch encryption setting and inspect secure context/WebCrypto, status renderer; config failure treated as disabled; UI diagnostic not transport security proof.

IntersectionObserver active section, ref map and translated answers; observer deps omit changing categories and cleanup reads current map. Special contribution item IDs absent from assigned faqData, so bespoke blocks unreachable through current list.
Translated question/answer search and smooth scroll sidebar; trim only for emptiness, search retains whitespace. Placeholder contact hrefs; no external requests.
Controlled search and clear button; icon clear lacks accessible label.

Read-only server classification and resolved lines, live flag blocks stale component writes; no HTTP status/payload validation so401 body can crash summary access; error/data not reset on identity changes. Absent and empty resolved list both hidden.
Radix alert dialog aliases and forwarded styled primitives; delegates focus/role handling to Radix.
Forward-ref styled HTML input, caller props preserved.
Portal custom select stringifies values; outside-click/scroll close listeners cleaned; no keyboard semantics/tabindex, disabled changing while open does not block option click.

Local bearer/session persistence and setup config; JWT expiry check on hydration only; malformed saved-user parsing repeats in fallback; login/admin/register/reset/logout direct fetch; 401 event listener cleanup. No SWR purge or active stream cancellation.
Persists en/zh/id language with localStorage, exposes context guard; storage access is not contained.
Nine FAQ category/key tables; retains crypto, competition, bounty entries. Actual translated answers outside scope except display routing.

Typed en/zh/id plan lifecycle, approval, owner-edit, guard/budget labels and interpolation. Labels are claims requiring backend verification; regex parameter names not escaped and string replacement expands dollar syntax.

zh/en/es strategy domains and helper fallback; app supports id not es, so id falls back English. Flat spreads collide (e.g.dailyLossLimit grid percent overwritten futures USD); plan registry uses separate keyspace.

Model/exchange config CRUD, optional RSA/AES browser encryption with user/session AAD, supported catalog reads and onboarding helpers; NinjaTrader create plain JSON; backend owns authentication/account constraints.
Status/account/positions/decisions/stats/history/competition API reads; account query only appended with traderID, mostly unencoded path IDs, runtime shape unchecked.
Converts standardized API failure to ApiError and friendly long-running timeout wording; no backend timeout cancellation guarantee.
Bearer header from localStorage, fetch status/text/JSON response handling; successful empty body cast empty object.
Strategy list/read/default/create/update/delete/activate/duplicate HTTP wrapper boundary; throws on failed API responses.
Get/update/unbind/model Telegram wrappers; plain HTTP JSON protected by bearer backend, no browser encryption layer.
clsx composition then tailwind class conflict merge.
Singleton cached config fetch promise; no response.ok validation, rejected promise retained until explicit invalidate; config is not evidence of live encryption/sandbox when unavailable.
Frontend CME symbol recognition shared helper; distinct from PositionsPanel stock heuristic.
Global confirmation registration refuses false if uninitialized, Sonner wrappers; provider owns concurrent confirmation lifecycle.
StrictMode browser router and Sonner root; imports styles and mounts React root.

Module-global reader/controller and Zustand message store; SSE plan/step/delta/done processing, CT timestamps and user-local history/drafts. Event type reset per network chunk drops split events; old cleanup touches new reader/loading; no abort on user change/unmount. Full trace and persistence implications in report.
Static404view and full-navigation home anchor; current wildcard route redirects home instead.

Auth/setup/legacy-hash routing plus trader dashboard polling. URL/memory/storage/stable fallback selection. Shared SWR keys and retry timeout callbacks; no user namespace or cache purge. Empty trader list returns without clearing selected trader.
Canonical route constants, pathname-to-page classification and encoded dashboard query construction.
Safe storage helpers; URL then memory then saved identifier then deterministic name/id sort; invalid stored selection cleared only on fallback branch.
Barrel exports traders config/modal stores; no own runtime methods.
Vitest localStorage mock with clear after each; empty stored string returns null unlike browser and no quota/security failure simulation.
Compile-time API shapes for accounts/positions/decisions/history/grid. Optional corrected-PnL semantics documented but COALESCE comment conflicts strict exclusion comment; no runtime validation.
Adaptive numeric formatting, strips/pads decimals. Null/undefined/NaN fabricated as0; infinity and invalid precision not bounded.
SMA, seeded EMA, population-variance Bollinger. EMA accesses first period without length guard; short history throws; nonpositive periods unchecked.
Vite client ambient types only.
Content globs, shared color/font/background/animation/shadow tokens; no runtime functions.
Loopback3001 strict preview proxy to8232; comment says untracked but file in baseline assignment. Config alone does not prove backend isolated/stopped.
